claim_texts: The manual says hazards cannot be activated with ignition OFF.
The hazard button is the triangle-marked button on the right-hand handlebar control.
Can you match that button on your bike?
If yes, activate hazards with ignition ON.
If you then turn the ignition OFF, they continue for up to 30 minutes unless manually switched off.
Hazard flashing strains the battery; avoid prolonged use unless necessary.
Turn signals do not work while hazards are ON.
For prolonged stops turn the ignition key OFF to avoid battery discharge.
